book.name: Mataio
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Mataio aime Iesu

content: Maiala Iesu ga ula ai Pilato
Urie, ileng ara ga mirier miridaip ganam ga teip mila uke maiam inamaniap onim Israel la okosarmeng ties meba menamung Iesu ga aving.
Pa tubiat la avismeng o iagur ga alagimeng ga ula ga maiabua na kilan a primia Pilato.
Iudas la uvara ra

Iudas iriro migana la uala Iesu na kilalap ma karorap, magimaong la abomaionama Iesu na ties ga maiabu giginanim abuo. Ga oigorula agat ang ga uaram miriro 30 ma kakepup silva la maialam miridaip mila kakanim aun, ga inagat ula ualam maun.
Ga tiesong gare ro, “Okosartung ara kirinim. Me iriro migana la tuala na kilalap mi, tale kan okosarong kirinim ba.” Pa mepulo ties ang gare ro, “Tale gat kiribasiap pam. Kiribasiap kan nuam.”
Ga magoong Iudas kakepup na luguan o lotu ga ula teuburi.
Miridaip mila Kakanim la maiaram mirio kakepup ga megama, “Urio uniap me unumuap ma inamaniap la mevara. Are ratmat ga baraba buabuam miriro kakepup na luguan o lotu.”
Ga meburio non ties me miriro kakepup meba asaumeng nap ba o kimanam maiang teip o ukosar a iouna o kimanam. Nameng me uriro kimanam le iot me una maiang inamaniap onim na pialap kakaliat.
Are ratmat ga iriro nap o kimanam la meivo bonim a, “Kimanam a olabuan” ga muio ga puoieng titot ga man iot ka.

Are ratmat ga non ties tinan Morowa la uaramo na nanam a unuli Ieremia la betieng migat. La tiesong gare ro, “Maiaram miriro 30 ma kakepup a silva. Israel la ovuomeng uriro uniap gare uniap meba asaumeng iriro migana.

content.text: ‘Ga me miriro kakepup la osaumeng kimanam ang migana la ume akosar iouna o kimanam, gare Ila Kakani la toulo.’” Sekaraia 11:12-13, Ieremia 32:6-9

content: Nunuo orong maiang Iudaiap, a?
Urie, Iesu la man dusong na irap a natauan gavaman Pilato, ga Pilato la amarikong gare ro, “Nunuo orong maiang Iudaiap, a?” Pa ugama Iesu, “Tiesnung ara.”
Pa miridaip mila kakanim ga teip mila uke la avuremeng Iesu ma papot tiesiap. Pa tale kan upulam tiesiap maiam.
Are ratmat ga inagat amarikong Pilato gare ro, “Atabo tale kan nuptam miriro tiesiap la novuremeng ma?”
Ga tale kan upulo Iesu ties ba ang Pilato. Are ratmat ga mitara turupuaba Pilato ga man agatong.
Pilato la tiesong meba asapmeng Iesu iro maiogun
Urie, mar mirie karaip na uriro la o Pasova, primia la ume avik non migana la unama na luguan o arubu. Teip ga magaulap la mime marik me migana ba ga ume avik Pilato ga ume ula mai.
Pa na iriro tara, ame non migana ila kire maset la unama na luguan o arubu, bonim a Barabas.
Teip ga magaulap la mumaio nebolameng ga mamarikong Pilato gare ro, “Naming la miga eba aviktang aga ga ala mi? Eba aviktang Barabas o eba aviktang iriro Iesu la meiva Karisito?”
Pilato la tiesong gare ro, memani mait la kiram dalap ma aime Iesu, ga alagimeng meba dusang na ties.

Ga are gat to, tara la unama Pilato bo luaga ang ias, kuala ang la osagaieng ties ga muio ai gare ro, “Baraba akosarnung paga ba ira iriro migana ila puvuvui. Na arubu la agimarung non kikiritniap ga ogasangentung giginanim ula kakanu.”
Pa miridaip mila kakanim ga teip mila uke la meiam dalap ma teip ga magaulap meba marikmeng me Pilato meba avikang Barabas pa menamung Iesu ga aving.
Pa primia la inagat mamarikong gare ro, “Naming la miga aviktang aga lie litiro teivien?” Pa teip ga magaulap la mepulo ties ang gare ro, “Barabas.”
Pa mamarikong Pilato, “Tie, naming le akosartang mani ira Iesu la meiva Karisito?” Pa mirie ganam la amarikmeng gare ro, “Asapnang iro maiogun.”
Pa mamarikong Pilato, “Me man paga? Man kirinim la okosarong?” Pa kukupmeng maranit maset kan, “Asapnang iro maiogun.”

Tie, Pilato la mait ara, tale kan puoong meba meptang ties ang, ga namo teiara danunumiap ula kakanu. Are ratmat ga uaro burunam ga magosong kilalap a na irap ma teip ga magaulap. Ga tiesong gare ro, “Tale kan kiribas tung leba aving iriro migana. Kiribas kan ming.”
Pa mirier teip ga magaulap ganam la mepulo ties ang gare ro, “Uriro kiribas le iot paun ga ira ma gat lop pam.”
Are ratmat ga avikong Pilato Barabas ga ula mai. Ga tiesong ga aisikmeng teip o danunumiap Iesu. Ga uala Iesu na kilalap ma teip o danunumiap, meba asapmeng iro maiogun.
Teip o danunumiap la fugaumeng ira Iesu
Urie, teip o danunumiap am Pilato la alagimeng Iesu ga ula uobu na luguan ang gavaman, ga mirier teip o danunumiap la mumaio nebolameng ai.
Ga meiniam sasaip am ga maiabua buruma ila taktogi ira a.

Ga maiaram iagurup mila sisirim ga okosarmeng begat gare ang orong ga maiabua na bugam a. Ga maiabu non pas na kilan a ila lamige ga makofmeng dadebip ma me ira a, ga fugaumeng ira a gare ro, “La ula muru, orong maiang Iudaiap.”
Ga akasupmeng ga maiaro uriro pas la maiabu na kilan a Iesu ga ovitmeng bugam a.
Makosarmeng miriro tavukup meba fugaumeng ira, ga ina meinia iriro buruma ira a ga inagat maiabua buruma ang kan. Ga alagimeng ga ula meba asapmeng iro maiogun.
Asapmeng Iesu iro maiogun
Urie, menum ga mela, pa teip o danunumiap la agimameng non migana onim na taun Sairini, bonim a Simon. Ga merana ga uavio maiogun ang Iesu.
Tie, mela betmeng na non pianam, bonim o Golgata. Muana o uriro bonim gare ro, ‘Pianam ma mualap o bugam.’
Maialo wain la origimeng ga kuguom ula babau kirat, meba tapo. Ga umero pa tale kan tapu.
Teip o danunumiap la asapmeng ara Iesu iro maiogun, tie sagumeng o satu meba mavuotmeng burap am kabirana ma kan.
Ga maionama na uriro pianam ga umaiale abuo.
Nakap bo bugam a, ut non paga la omirmeng uriro ties la maiabua na ties ume. Omirmeng ties gare ro, ‘Iriro Iesu, orong maiang Iudaiap.’
Tie, kagarat ai Iesu lesapmeng narain teipien o pula, irie na kilan ila lamige pa irie na kilan ila avaong.
Pa teip ga magaulap la mime mela ga mumaio, la mime ties o fugau ira a ga mime maritigi bugabip ma.
Ga megama, “Nunuo migana o udure a luguan o lotu ga eba ina neraling na naien ma lap, tie teaganalie kan. Leba migat ba nunuo Poi ang Morowa, tie onolaing maiogun ga munang lourup.”
Miridaip mila kakanim ga teip o usingnualap o maimai ga teip mila uke onim Israel, mirie gat la fugaumeng garet tie ga megama.
“Magaulie non teip pa tale kan teagaulie kan. Irie orong onim Israel. Tie, eba oolaing maiogun ga muong lourup, meba naganpang ira a.
Naganong ira Morowa ga ugama, ‘Turuo Poi ang Morowa.’ Tie, leba naang Morowa aime, tie eba aagaalie titot.”
Narain teipien o pula la lesapmeng iro maiogun kagarat ai Iesu, litie gat la liaramo ties o fugau aime.
Iesu la uvara
Urie, na 12 o muabari, arubu la ialu kimanam gano, ga ila puoieng na naien o muabari nabit.
Pa kagarat u naien o muabari Iesu la marikong maranit gare ro, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Muana o uriro ties gare ro, “Morowa ruang, Morowa ruang, memani ga tonulai?”
Non teip la dusmeng kagarat la mepto uriro ties ga megama, “Iriro migana la amarikong Elia.”
Pa kakalait ibirong non ma ga ula uaro spongi o pirom ga uabu na wain. Pa tara la dakong a wain, ovisong iro pas ga ualo me aun Iesu meba tapo.
Pa non teip la megama, “Miairang ka irie. Ga agimabuong Elia la eba muong meba aagaalie o karuk.”
Pa Iesu la inagat marikong maranit gat ga uaira muranam a ga ula ga uvara.

Urie, a iriro tara, irie buruma ila kakani la sapong tapma na luguan o lotu la giritong mavuo nakap ga ula lourup, ga betong ga narain napupien a. Ga didirieng kimanam ga tadasip mila kakanim la paparagenmeng.
Ga menava unap ga papot teip ga magaulap am Morowa, tinan la mevara, titot la inar temaiara.
Amaiolai una, pa tubiat la inar teuara Iesu, mela maiobu na taun ula puaru ang Morowa, ga papot ma teip ga magaulap la magimameng.

Migana ila uke me 100 ma teip o danunumiap ga teip o danunumiap la umaiale bo Iesu la man maionama, ogimameng kimanam la didirieng ga pagap la betmeng, ga merau maset. Ga tiesmeng gare ro, “Migat ara, iriro migana irie Poi ang Morowa.”
Tie, papot gat ma magaulap la maionama la ameuluo Iesu ga omaiolai Galili meba mumaiong aagamelie. Miriro magaulap la dusmeng kakaliat tarot ga man umai.
Non magabun kabirana ma, urie Maria onim Makdala. Pa non ba Maria, naga ang Iemes ga Iosep. Pa urie naga liong lopien angan Sebedi.
Maiabua tongan Iesu na lu a tadas
Urie, nabit non migana ma kakepup onim na taun Arimatai, bonim a Iosep la muo. Irie gat non migana ang Iesu o usingnualap.
Ula ai Pilato ga amarikong meba airang meba arang tongan Iesu. Tie, Pilato la maulo teip o danunumiap meba maialang tongan aun Iosep.
Ga uara Iosep tongan ga ualua na buruma ila babai ila pasokong.
Ga uavia tongan ga ula uabua tapma na una a tadas kan ang ila nei. Ga arigiong non tadas ila kakani ga ualua nanam a lu. Okosarong ara gare riro ga ula.
Maria onim Makdala ga non gat Maria la man lionama kagarat ai una ga man uli.
Teip o danunumiap la umaiale bo una
Urie, la o uranga ma pagap me la o sabat la no ra, pa urie non la tubiat, miridaip mila kakanim ga Parasaiop la nebolameng iat ga mela agimameng Pilato.
Amelo gare ro, “Migana ila kakani, onagipang non ties iriro migana o kakarabunim la uaramo na tara la unama ka. Ugama, ‘Tubiat na naien ma lap eba ina terara.’

Are ratmat ga manalava teip o danunumiap meba meulung maset una puoieng ma naien ma lap. Babun lop am o usingnualap leba apulameng tongan ga mamelava teip ga magaulap gare ro, ‘Inar teuara na una.’ Pa uriro ties ula nou o kakarabunim eba okurupeling ties o kakarabunim la uaramo tinan.”
Tie, maulo Pilato gare ro, “Malagiming teip mim mila maiario kier ga mamilava meba umaialeng bo iriro una. Mila ga makosarming mirier pagap la miga makosarming meba miulung maranit iriro una.”
Tie, mela meulua una. Ga maiabua kaguma meba tebunakang iriro tadas la ut na nanam a lu, ga maiabuam teip mila maiabua begat meba umaialeng bo una.
